record.question: If M does not have any son, then how is R related to D?
record.explanation: Using the ordinary shared-parent family-tree interpretation of the printed puzzle, P, R and H are M and S's children. Since M has no sons, R is P's sister. D is P's son, so R is D's aunt. The full shared family statement is required for this conclusion. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed paper and worked derivation checked on 26 October 2026.
record.direction: Direction (Question Nos. 96–98): Read the following information carefully and answer the following questions.
record.passage:
D is the son of P.
P is the daughter of M.
S is married to M.
R and H are children of S.
W is the husband of H.
K is the son of W.
